description: This PHP class defines a DateRange Data Transfer Object (DTO) for handling date ranges with optional 'from' and 'to' dates, including getter and setter methods.

classes.name: DateRange
classes.description: A DTO class representing a range between two optional dates, with methods to access and modify the 'from' and 'to' dates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the 'fromDate' and 'toDate' properties, optionally accepting DateTime objects.
